mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id, a.original_filename, a.attachment_path, a.access_key, a.create_time, a.deleted_time, a.status, u.username FROM attachment a JOIN user_information u ON a.uuid = u.uuid WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT a.uuid, a.attachment_id, a.original_filename, a.attachment_path, a.access_key, a.create_time, a.deleted_time, a.status, u.username FROM attachment a JOIN user_information u ON a.uuid = u.uuid WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE status = 1

SELECT a.uuid, a.attachment_id, a.original_filename, a.attachment_path, a.access_key, a.create_time, a.deleted_time, a.status, u.username FROM attachment a JOIN user_information u ON a.uuid = u.uuid WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.uuid = #{uuid} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE status = 1 AND uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT a.uuid, a.attachment_id, a.original_filename, a.attachment_path, a.access_key, a.create_time, a.deleted_time, a.status, u.username FROM attachment a JOIN user_information u ON a.uuid = u.uuid WHERE a.attachment_id = #{attachmentId}

SELECT a.uuid, a.attachment_id, a.attachment_path, a.original_filename, a.access_key, a.create_time, a.deleted_time, a.status, u.username FROM attachment a JOIN user_information u ON a.uuid = u.uuid WHERE a.status = 1 OR (a.status = 0 AND a.deleted_time >= #{cutoff}) ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE status = 1 OR (status = 0 AND deleted_time >= #{cutoff})

SELECT a.uuid, a.attachment_id, a.original_filename, a.attachment_path, a.access_key, a.create_time, a.deleted_time, a.status, u.username FROM attachment a JOIN user_information u ON a.uuid = u.uuid WHERE (a.status = 1 OR (a.status = 0 AND a.deleted_time >= #{cutoff})) AND a.uuid = #{uuid} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE (status = 1 OR (status = 0 AND deleted_time >= #{cutoff})) AND uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE status = 1 AND uuid = #{userUuid}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE (status = 1 OR (status = 0 AND deleted_time >= #{cutoff})) AND uuid = #{userUuid}
